name: Brad Sweatt
why: The only photograph of him found: the labelled campaign mugshot run with the 1998 public relations race. Small newspaper halftone, about 194px wide at the scan's native resolution, but sharp and full-face.
caption_quote: Name: Brad Sweatt Hometown: Central City Class: Junior Major: Chemistry/Biology
id_note: Three candidate portraits run in a row across the foot of the page, each with its own label block set immediately to its left: Amy France, then Christoph Miller, then Sweatt at the right. Sweatt's block sits against the plaid-shirted man, which is this crop.

name: Christoph Miller
why: The only photograph of him found: the labelled campaign mugshot run with the 1998 public relations race. Small newspaper halftone, about 194px wide at native scan resolution, but sharp and full-face.
caption_quote: Name: Christoph Miller Hometown: Hendersonville, Tenn. Class: Junior Major: Public relations
id_note: Three candidate portraits run across the foot of the page, each with its label block immediately to its left: Amy France, Miller, Brad Sweatt. Miller's block sits against the middle portrait, the man in the dark shirt, which is this crop.

name: Carleton Ruminer
why: The labelled campaign mugshot run with the 1998 treasurer race, and the only photograph of him found. Small newspaper halftone, about 202px wide at native scan resolution, slightly flat, but full-face and in focus.
caption_quote: Name: Carleton Ruminer Hometown: Evansville Class: Sophomore Major: Business
id_note: Two candidate portraits sit side by side under the story, each with its label block immediately to its left: Ruminer's block against the left-hand portrait, Joe Matheis' against the right-hand one. This crop is the left-hand portrait.

name: Ryan Morrison
why: Mugshot run with the April 1999 treasurer race, inside his 1998-99 year and the only photograph of him found. Small and heavily contrasted by the halftone screen, but the face is unmistakable.
id_note: Two mugshots run side by side at the head of the story with a name set under each: Ryan Morrison under the left, Joe Matheis under the right. This crop is the left portrait.

name: Matthew D. Bastin
why: Captioned mugshot run with the April 1999 race for public relations vice president, inside his year as administrative vice president. Small newspaper halftone, 185px wide at the scan's native resolution, but sharp, full-face and unobstructed.
id_note: The name is set in bold directly beneath this portrait; the second portrait lower in the same column carries Duan Wright's name beneath it in the same way.

name: Matt Bastin
why: The captioned mugshot run with his April 1999 campaign for public relations vice president, the office he then held this year. Small newspaper halftone but sharp, full-face and unobstructed.
id_note: The name is set in bold directly beneath this portrait; the second portrait lower in the same column carries Duan Wright's name beneath it in the same way.

name: Brandon Griffey
why: The only photograph of him found. Marred: a circular stain on the archived page falls across the right side of his face, taking one eye with it. Published because the alternative is no face at all; replace it if a clean frame turns up.
id_note: Three candidate mugshots run in a row across the top of the story, each with its name set in bold directly beneath it: Mike Wiatr, Amanda Kirby, Brandon Griffey. This is the third.

name: Amy Caswell
why: Captioned portrait run with the profile of her campaign for finance vice president, the office she went on to hold in 2000-01. Only 163px wide at the scan's native resolution, but evenly lit, sharp and full-face.
id_note: The name is set in bold directly under this portrait, the only photograph on the page, beside the story about her.

name: Josh Detre
why: A large, well-lit head-and-shoulders portrait, much bigger than the mugshots the Herald ran with its election stories, from the paper's own advertisement for its presidential debate. The newspaper printed it tilted, so the page scan was rotated 13 degrees to set the face upright; nothing else was altered.
id_note: The name is set in bold immediately beneath the portrait, inside the Herald's own house advertisement headed 'Find Out What The Presidential Candidates Are All About!', which runs across pages 10 and 11 with one named candidate portrait per page.

name: Mark Rawlings
why: Captioned portrait run beside the story on the public relations race, during his year as finance vice president. Only 148px wide because this issue was scanned at a lower resolution than the 1998 and 1999 volumes, but well lit and in focus.
id_note: The name is set in bold directly beneath this portrait at the head of his half of the story; Holly Skidmore's portrait and name are set the same way in the right-hand half.

name: Jamil Sewell
why: Captioned portrait, coat and tie, run with the profile of him as an incoming executive officer, the office (vice president of administration) the archive's organization record confirms him holding in 2001-02, not the 2000-01 the campaign coverage's own date suggested. Only 141px wide because this issue was scanned at a lower resolution than the 1998 and 1999 volumes.
id_note: Two portraits sit in the double story, each with its name set in bold immediately beneath: Jamil Sewell in the left half, Aaron Spencer in the right. This is the left one.

name: Anna Coats
why: Captioned portrait run with her candidate profile in the 2002 elections coverage, while she chaired the public relations committee. Small and a little grainy, but evenly lit and full-face.
id_note: The name is set in bold directly beneath this portrait, in the left-hand half of a two-candidate page; Holly Skidmore's portrait and name are set the same way in the right-hand half.

name: Heather Rogers
why: The mugshot the Herald ran with her signed commentary defending SGA, and the only photograph of her found. 145px wide at the scan's native resolution, but sharp, evenly lit and full-face.
id_note: Her name and the word Commentary are set in bold immediately to the left of this portrait, at the head of the piece she signed; the rival commentary in the left-hand column carries Andy Spears' name and portrait in the same arrangement. The editor's note at the foot of her column identifies her as a senior public relations major from Alvaton and the SGA public relations director.

name: Joe Morel
why: Captioned mugshot run with the story on his and Jason Nemes' campaign for the executive ticket, during his year as vice-chair of campus improvements. Small and contrasty, but a clear full-face frame and the only photograph of him found.
id_note: Two mugshots run down the right-hand edge of the story with a name set in bold beneath each: Jason Nemes above, Joe Morel below. This is the lower one.
